thread:
maya: Hey folks, noticed the scorecard drilldown for the FP8 quant run shows 1.2k total samples in the summary, but the diff view drilldown returns only 820 rows. Seems like samples are getting dropped somewhere. anyone seen this before? :thinking:

dylan: Huh. Which dashboard/scorecard? the quantization one under 'regressions -> weekly'?

maya: yep — Scorecard: quant-experiments / 'FP8-run-2026-03-18'. The top-level buckets (accuracy, bad_token_rate) all aggregate over 1200 samples, but when I click a bucket to inspect examples I only get ~820.

sasha: Could be a runner export dedupe step. We had a bug a while back where runner would reuse sample_id if job got retried in CI. That would make the drilldown query (which does SELECT DISTINCT sample_id ...) drop rows. I filed a note: PR #4123 fixed part of it but might not cover retried-chunk IDs.

qa-bot: test-run: fp8-2026-03-18 | job_id=run-9882 | samples=1200 | exported=1200 | rows_in_export=1200 | checksum=3f5b2e

maya: here's the query the dashboard uses (simplified):
```sql
SELECT DISTINCT sample_id, input, output, metric_vals
FROM eval_samples
WHERE scorecard_id = 'fp8-2026-03-18' AND metric_bucket = 'bad_token_rate'
ORDER BY metric_vals->>'bad_token_rate' DESC
LIMIT 500
```

dylan: aha — DISTINCT on sample_id + an export that has duplicate sample_id but different row ids could reduce results. if export file had duplicates, the top-level COUNT(*) could still be 1200 while DISTINCT(sample_id) becomes 820. can you share a small export slice?

maya: attached a CSV excerpt in the thread (pasted below). you can see sample_id 12345 appears 3x with different chunk_idx.
```csv
sample_id,chunk_idx,input,output
12345,0,"How do I...","..."
12345,1,"How do I...","..."
12346,0,"Explain X","..."
```

sasha: that matches the old retried-chunk behavior. CI runner was concatenating chunked exports and not normalizing sample_id, so duplicates appear when chunks overlap. I think the right fix is to change the dashboard query to dedupe on (sample_id, chunk_idx) OR better: make runner export unique sample_id per row. I'll open a patch.

jeff: short-term we should update the scorecard summary to show both raw rows and unique sample count so people don't get confused. also add a note in the drilldown legend: "Rows may be deduped by sample_id".

eva: I'll triage repro locally. plan: run the runner with a forced retry and then run the same dashboard query to see counts. steps:
1) ./tools/runner --job run-9882 --force-retry --seed 42 --samples 200\2) cat /tmp/run-9882/export/*.csv | wc -l\3) run the SQL from the dashboard against local sqlite dump
I'll post logs.

maya: thanks — assigning to @eva for now. Sasha if you can open the PR for the runner dedupe, tag me and dylan. jeff can you update the dashboard legend?

sasha: on it, will reference PR #4123 follow-up. ETA EOD.

jeff: will add a quick tooltip and change the summary card to show "unique samples" vs "exported rows". ETA morning.

eva: repro looks good — confirmed duplicate sample_ids after forced retry. log snippet:
```
INFO 2026-03-18 11:02:43 chunk_exporter: writing chunk run-9882-0 rows=200
INFO 2026-03-18 11:02:46 chunk_exporter: retry triggered, writing chunk run-9882-1 rows=200
INFO 2026-03-18 11:02:48 final export rows=400 (unique_sample_ids=278)
```

maya: perfect — sounds like a plan. after PR and dashboard tweak, we should re-run the scorecard generation for FP8 run and verify numbers match. also add a quick CI test that prevents reintroduced regressions (assert exported_rows >= unique_sample_ids). :white_check_mark:

dylan: agree. also add a small note in the run metadata tab that quant experiments often use chunking and retries so counts may differ. that'll avoid confusion for non-ML folks looking at the console.

qa-bot: created ticket #ML-720: "dashboard shows raw rows != unique samples for chunked exports" and linked PR #4123-pt2.

maya: thanks all. closing the loop when PRs land and reconcilation run passes. :thumbsup:
